latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Game Music Maker — Generate Music for Game Videos.

- Instantly generate royalty-free background music for your game videos by uploading footage or providing a prompt.
- Handles all music generation, video merging, and export in the cloud—no local installation needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM video uploads up to 500MB, plus many image and audio formats.
- Simple prompts trigger tailored background music creation, with finished 1080p MP4 exports ready for use.
- Easy credit system with free starter tokens for new users; seamless session and export handling.
- Built for indie game devs and creators needing quick, high-quality scene-specific music without hiring a composer.
